'''''Defiance's Banner''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] ex-[[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora's]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdout]] forces in the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent a task force led by the [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']] to hunt down ''Defiance{{'s}} Banner''.
